exercises.title: A view of department 1 without salaries
exercises.problemHtml:
Team leads of department 1 may see their staff but not their salaries. Create view vwDep1Staff with the SSN, name and sex of every employee of department 1.

FUHCompany schema (the course's sample database — full script in the FUHCompany.sql tab)
TableColumns (PK underlined, FK in italics)
tblEmployeeempSSN DECIMAL(18,0), empName NVARCHAR(50), empAddress NVARCHAR(100), empSalary DECIMAL(10,0), empSex CHAR(1) (F/M), empBirthdate DATE, depNum → tblDepartment, supervisorSSN → tblEmployee
tblDepartmentdepNum INT, depName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, mgrSSN → tblEmployee, mgrAssDate DATE
tblProjectproNum INT, proName NVARCHAR(50), locNum → tblLocation, depNum → tblDepartment
tblWorksOnempSSN, proNum, workHours DECIMAL(5,1)
tblLocationlocNum INT, locName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE
tblDepLocationdepNum, locNum
tblDependentempSSN, depName NVARCHAR(50), depSex CHAR(1), depBirthdate DATE, depRelationship NVARCHAR(30)

14 employees, 5 departments, 6 projects, 16 work assignments, 5 dependents. Names are Vietnamese with diacritics; text compares case-insensitively as on SQL Server.

Requirements

  • View name vwDep1Staff; columns empSSN, empName, empSex.
  • The view must stay correct when department 1 hires — it is a query, not a copy.

CREATE TABLE tblLocation (

);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (

    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (

    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,

);

exercises.title: A view that hides a join
exercises.problemHtml:
Reports keep joining employees with departments. Create view vwEmployeeDept returning every employee's SSN, name and department name (as DepartmentName).

FUHCompany schema (the course's sample database — full script in the FUHCompany.sql tab)
TableColumns (PK underlined, FK in italics)

tblDepartmentdepNum INT, depName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, mgrSSN → tblEmployee, mgrAssDate DATE

CREATE VIEW vwProjectStaffing AS
SELECT p.proNum, p.proName,
       COUNT(w.empSSN)               AS NumStaff,
       COALESCE(SUM(w.workHours), 0) AS TotalHours
FROM tblProject p
LEFT JOIN tblWorksOn w ON w.proNum = p.proNum
GROUP BY p.proNum, p.proName;

exercises.title: Updatable view WITH CHECK OPTION
exercises.problemHtml:
Create view vwHighEarners showing SSN, name and salary of employees earning at least 80,000, so that HR can update salaries through the view — but an update that would push someone below 80,000 (and make them vanish from the view) must be rejected.

tblDepartmentdepNum INT, depName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, mgrSSN → tblEmployee, mgrAssDate DATE
